business_problem: CTG had accumulated multiple infrastructure platforms that made it difficult to balance resource usage, upgrade architectures, and centralize management. Its power stations were spread across multiple provinces, so IT and OT data could not be easily shared across systems, and operational knowledge was hard to consolidate when staff turned over.
solution_summary: CTG used Huawei Cloud Stack to replace multiple infrastructure platforms with a single group-wide cloud that could be centrally planned, shared, and deployed. On that foundation, DataArts Studio serves as the data governance center, accessing statistics collected at the edge from underwater robots, generator sets, and motor rotors at power stations and standardizing them for shared use. FusionInsight MRS then provides the real-time data lake where CTG correlates and converges IT and OT data, builds big data models, and supports analytics applications for power generation. Those governed datasets feed CTG's industrial Internet platform so monitoring, operations, maintenance, production, and decision-making applications can work from the same real-time information across provinces instead of scattered silos.

solution_components.name: Huawei Cloud Stack
solution_components.role: Provides the single, unified cloud and centralized resource provisioning for CTG's group-wide deployment.

solution_components.name: DataArts Studio
solution_components.role: Acts as the data governance center and accesses equipment statistics from edge-connected power-station systems for shared use.

solution_components.name: FusionInsight MRS
solution_components.role: Implements the real-time data lake and supports correlation analysis, data convergence, and big-data modeling for CTG's power-generation use cases.

solution_components.name: industrial Internet platform
solution_components.role: Hosts the monitoring, O&M, production, and decision-making applications that consume the governed datasets.

data_flow: Statistics from underwater robots, generator sets, and motor rotors at power stations are accessed at the edge through DataArts Studio, governed and converged into shared datasets, then loaded into FusionInsight MRS as a real-time data lake for correlation analysis and big-data modeling. The resulting data products power CTG's industrial Internet platform and 11 major monitoring, maintenance, production, and decision-making applications.
integration_points: Power-station monitoring, operations, device maintenance, production, and decision-making applications
business_outcome: CTG centralized cloud resource provisioning and data governance on one unified cloud, connected 100 GB of data from more than 5,000 tables and over 60 data sources, turned it into 3,000 data assets in more than 50 categories, enabled real-time analytics for 11 major applications, detected a falling thrust-bearing fuel level 10 days in advance, and improved reporting efficiency 9-fold.
metrics: 100 GB of data included in more than 5,000 tables from over 60 data sources has been connected to the cloud, and turned into 3,000 data assets in more than 50 categories.
The numerous data assets facilitate real-time service data analytics for 11 major applications including operations, device maintenance, and production at power stations.
The platform can identify a falling fuel level for a thrust bearing 10 days in advance.
Plus, data analysis reports can be automatically generated, which results in a 9-fold improvement in efficiency.
